scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Cardiology Device Update Grand Rounds from carrying an avoidable accessibility gap into Tuesday’s overflow feed.
Emerging Need: A routine auditorium lecture becomes risky after an uncaptained procedural video and overflow live-feed plan align while source settings remain editable.
Decision Context: Early schedule and deck traffic do not justify AV outreach; later capacity and source-freeze notices make a reversible no-cost check useful, with the approved routing rule held in activity records.
Consequence: If no caption-source path is opened before the list freezes, overflow attendees may receive narrated video content without usable captions during the accredited session.

parameter.title: Cardiology Device Update Grand Rounds
parameter.description: Accredited grand rounds session; standard auditorium lecture setup and sign-in table.

parameter.subject: Draft deck for Cardiology Device Update Grand Rounds
parameter.body: Elodie, attached is the working deck for Tuesday. I added a five-minute prerecorded device-implant workflow clip with spoken narration; the export I have does not show embedded captions yet. I am not changing the clinical discussion slides, but the video timing is now part of the run-of-show.

parameter.content: Registration count just hit 138 for Tuesday morning. Main auditorium seating is 120, so facilities is preparing Education Room B as an overflow live-feed room if the count holds Monday. No separate facilitator is planned for that room.

parameter.subject: Tuesday auditorium overflow source list freezes today
parameter.body: For Tuesday's main-auditorium overflow encoder setup, the source list is still editable until 16:30 today. Caption overlays and audio-source checks received before that cutoff can be bundled into the Education Room B feed test. After the source list freezes, overlay changes move to next-week exceptions.

parameter.subject: Tuesday overflow source list is now frozen
parameter.body: The 16:30 source-list freeze has passed for Tuesday's auditorium overflow feed. Education Room B will mirror the deck source as received for the live session. New caption-overlay or source-check requests will be queued for sessions after Tuesday.
